question.text: 'Saraswati Growth Fund' has INR 500 crore commitments. Over 4 years, 85% of commitments have been called. What is the aggregate capital still unfunded?

explanation.text: The Logic: Unfunded commitment = 15% x INR 500 crore = INR 75 crore. This residual may be reserved for follow-on investments, fund expenses or the sponsor's pro-rata share. The Trap: INR 50 cr uses 10%. INR 85 cr confuses 85 with the percent. INR 100 cr uses 20%. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests the unfunded math. XIX-D extends to follow-on strategy questions. Manager's Pro-Tip: Reserve 10-20% of commitments for follow-ons in growth and VC strategies - exhausting 100% of commitments on initial tickets leaves no capital for defensive or pro-rata rounds.
